text.2:49: And (remember) when We did deliver you from Pharaoh's folk, who were afflicting you with dreadful torment, slaying your sons and sparing your women: that was a tremendous trial from your Lord.
text.6:63: Say: Who delivereth you from the darkness of the land and the sea? Ye call upon Him humbly and in secret, (saying): If we are delivered from this (fear) we truly will be of the thankful.
text.6:64: Say: Allah delivereth you from this and from all affliction. Yet ye attribute partners unto Him.
text.7:89: We should have invented a lie against Allah if we returned to your religion after Allah hath rescued us from it. It is not for us to return to it unless Allah our Lord should (so) will. Our Lord comprehendeth all things in knowledge. In Allah do we put our trust. Our Lord! Decide with truth between us and our folk, for Thou art the best of those who make decision.
text.10:73: But they denied him, so We saved him and those with him in the ship, and made them viceroys (in the earth), while We drowned those who denied Our revelations. See then the nature of the consequence for those who had been warned.
text.10:86: And, of Thy mercy, save us from the folk that disbelieve.
text.10:92: But this day We save thee in thy body that thou mayst be a portent for those after thee. Lo! most of mankind are heedless of Our portents.
text.10:103: Then shall We save Our messengers and the believers, in like manner (as of old). It is incumbent upon Us to save believers.
text.11:58: And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Hud and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; We saved them from a harsh doom.
text.11:66: So, when Our commandment came to pass, We saved Salih, and those who believed with him, by a mercy from Us, from the ignominy of that day. Lo, thy Lord! He is the Strong, the Mighty.
text.11:94: And when Our commandment came to pass We saved Shu'eyb and those who believed with him by a mercy from Us; and the (Awful) Cry seized those who did injustice, and morning found them prostrate in their dwellings,
text.12:110: Till, when the messengers despaired and thought that they were denied, then came unto them Our help, and whom We would was saved. And Our wrath cannot be warded from the guilty.
text.17:67: And when harm toucheth you upon the sea, all unto whom ye cry (for succour) fail save Him (alone), but when He bringeth you safe to land, ye turn away, for man was ever thankless.
text.19:72: Then We shall rescue those who kept from evil, and leave the evil-doers crouching there.
text.20:40: When thy sister went and said: Shall I show you one who will nurse him? and we restored thee to thy mother that her eyes might be refreshed and might not sorrow. And thou didst kill a man and We delivered thee from great distress, and tried thee with a heavy trial. And thou didst tarry years among the folk of Midian. Then camest thou (hither) by (My) providence, O Moses,
text.21:71: And We rescued him and Lot (and brought them) to the land which We have blessed for (all) peoples.
text.21:74: And unto Lot we gave judgment and knowledge, and We delivered him from the community that did abominations. Lo! they were folk of evil, lewd.
text.21:76: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
text.21:88: Then we heard his prayer and saved him from the anguish. Thus we save believers.
text.23:28: And when thou art on board the ship, thou and whoso is with thee, then say: Praise be to Allah Who hath saved us from the wrongdoing folk!
text.26:118: Therefor judge Thou between us, a (conclusive) judgment, and save me and those believers who are with me.
text.26:169: My Lord! Save me and my household from what they do.
text.26:170: So We saved him and his household, every one,
text.28:21: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.
text.29:32: He said: Lo! Lot is there. They said: We are best aware of who is there. We are to deliver him and his household, all save his wife, who is of those who stay behind.
text.29:65: And when they mount upon the ships they pray to Allah, making their faith pure for Him only, but when He bringeth them safe to land, behold! they ascribe partners (unto Him),
text.31:32: And if a wave enshroudeth them like awnings, they cry unto Allah, making their faith pure for Him only. But when He bringeth them safe to land, some of them compromise. None denieth Our signs save every traitor ingrate.
text.37:76: And We saved him and his household from the great distress,
text.37:115: And saved them and their people from the great distress,
text.37:134: When We saved him and his household, every one,
text.39:61: And Allah delivereth those who ward off (evil) because of their deserts. Evil toucheth them not, nor do they grieve.
text.41:18: And We delivered those who believed and used to keep their duty to Allah.
text.44:30: And We delivered the Children of Israel from the shameful doom;
text.54:34: Lo! We sent a storm of stones upon them (all) save the family of Lot, whom We rescued in the last watch of the night,
text.66:11: And Allah citeth an example for those who believe: the wife of Pharaoh when she said: My Lord! Build for me a home with thee in the Garden, and deliver me from Pharaoh and his work, and deliver me from evil-doing folk;
